app.name: GTO Trainer
auth.needLogin: Log in to practice drills and track your progress.
auth.hint: Username: 3-24 letters, digits, _ or -. Password: 8-128 characters.
err.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
err.invalid_username: Username must be 3-24 characters: letters, digits, _ or -.
err.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
progress.title: Your progress
progress.empty: No answers yet. Complete a drill to see your progress here.
hh.title: Hand-history analysis (turn and river)
hh.disclaimer: Approximate analysis. Ranges are hand-written presets narrowed by simple rules, not your opponents' real ranges, and only heads-up turn and river decisions are solved. Results are an estimate, never "GTO-exact".
hh.tooltip: Preset {preset}; top {top} of the range kept plus {bluff} bluffs; largest bet-size mismatch {delta} of pot; heads-up abstraction; solver exploitability {expl} of pot ({iters}).
hh.paste: Paste hand histories (PokerStars, GGPoker or iPoker (Hold'em Manager 3 text export), English, no-limit hold'em cash)
hh.summary: {ok, plural, one {# hand parsed} other {# hands parsed}}, {rejected, plural, one {# rejected} other {# rejected}}
hh.analysable: Turn or river decision can be analysed
hh.noResults: No decisions yet. Parse hands and press analyse.
hh.upload: Upload decisions to my account (requires login)
hh.uploadHint: Nothing is sent to the server unless you log in and press upload.
hh.uploaded: {saved, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}} saved; {added, plural, one {# hand} other {# hands}} added, {duplicates, plural, one {# duplicate} other {# duplicates}} skipped.
hh.override.title: Overrides (optional)
hh.reason.no_preset: No range preset for these positions or pot type
hh.reason.range_empty: Range is empty on this board
hh.reason.off_tree: Bet size or raise not representable
hh.reason.turn_small_menu: Reduced bet-size menu (full turn solve too slow)
hh.list.needLogin: Log in to see your uploaded hands.
hh.list.empty: No hands match. Import and upload hands first, or change the filters.
hh.replay.title: Hand replay
hh.replay.stacksMissing: Stacks are not available for this hand (the stored hand does not list both seats).
hh.replay.assume: Assumptions: preset {preset}; you keep the top {heroTop} of your range plus {heroBluff} bluffs, the opponent the top {vilTop} plus {vilBluff}; bet sizes mapped onto the solver menu; heads-up abstraction.
hh.replay.noDecision: No analysis stored for this action.
hh.prog.empty: No analysed hands yet. Import, analyse and upload hands to see them here.
hh.prog.note: Played-hand numbers use approximate ranges and are never added to your drill totals.
hh.prog.decisions: {count, plural, one {# analysed decision} other {# analysed decisions}}
hh.data.title: My data
hh.data.confirmHands: Delete all your uploaded hand histories and their analysis? This cannot be undone.
hh.data.confirmAll: Delete your hand histories, their analysis and your drill results? Your account stays. This cannot be undone.
hh.data.done: Deleted: {hands, plural, one {# hand} other {# hands}}, {decisions, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}}.
hh.solvingStage: Turn and river solves can take up to 20 seconds per hand; press cancel to stop.
strategy.hint: Hover, tap or use the arrow keys on a hand to see its strategy.
seq.title: Action sequence
solver.err.board.cards: Board: use cards like As Kd 7c 4h 2s (rank 2-9 T J Q K A, suit c d h s).
solver.err.board.dup: Board: a card appears more than once.
solver.err.chips: Pot and stack must be numbers greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000.
drill.closeHint: Rarely played by the solver, but the EV loss is small.
hh.tooLarge: The pasted text is too large (max 2 MB).
err.session: Your session expired. Your answer was not saved. Log in again to continue.
engine.err.memory: The solver ran out of memory for this spot. Try smaller sizes or a narrower range.
engine.err.generic: The solver could not process this input.
acct.title: Account
acct.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all its data permanently? This cannot be undone.
preflop3.mode.label: Stack depth
preflop3.mode.missing: No solution pack is loaded for {stacks} BB, so that mode is disabled. Import a pack file to enable it.
preflop3.sit.limp: {hero} to act after a limp from {villain}
preflop3.sit.facingRaise: {hero} facing a raise to {size} BB from {villain}
preflop3.sit.facingAllin: {hero} facing an all-in of {size} BB from {villain}
preflop3.prompt: Choose your action before the solution is shown.
preflop3.verdict.detail: You chose {action}; the pack plays it {freq} of the time with {hand}.
preflop3.verdict.closeNote: Counts as incorrect, but only {ev} BB of EV is lost.
preflop3.bars.title: Pack frequencies for {hand}
preflop3.matrix.title: Range at this node
preflop3.matrix.aria: Range matrix, 13 by 13 hands; your hand is outlined
preflop3.matrix.hint: Each cell is split by action frequency; empty cells are never played here. Your hand is outlined.
preflop3.expl.title: Explanation
preflop3.expl.chosen: With {hand} as {hero} you chose {action}: the pack plays it {freq} of the time.
preflop3.expl.ev: EV difference to the best action: {ev} BB.
preflop3.expl.pot: Pot {pot} BB, {call} BB to call, pot odds {odds}, stack-to-pot ratio {spr}.
preflop3.expl.potFree: Pot {pot} BB, nothing to call, stack-to-pot ratio {spr}.
preflop3.expl.rank: {share} of the range plays {action} more often than {hand}.
preflop3.badge.unverified: UNVERIFIED: computed by this app's own solver, not checked against an external solver
preflop3.score.loginForAllTime: Log in to see all-time progress.
preflop3.score.resetConfirm: Reset the session counters? Saved all-time progress is kept.
preflop3.saveErr: The result could not be saved to your account.
preflop3.empty.title: No solution pack available
preflop3.empty.body: This trainer only shows strategies that come from a solution pack, and no usable pack is loaded, so there is nothing to practise yet. A solution pack must be provided: import a pack file from your device (it stays in this browser and is never uploaded) or ask the site owner to publish one.
preflop3.import.ok: Imported pack {packId} ({stack} BB). It stays in this browser.
preflop3.import.failed: Import failed: {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}
preflop3.err.E_STRUCTURE: A required object or list is missing or has the wrong type.
preflop3.err.E_META_FIELD: A meta field is missing or invalid.
preflop3.err.E_ICM_PAYOUTS: ICM payouts are missing or invalid.
preflop3.err.E_CLASSES: The 169 hand classes are not in canonical order.
preflop3.err.E_ACTION_KIND: Invalid action kind or action list.
preflop3.err.E_CHILD_MISSING: A child node does not exist.
preflop3.err.E_UNREACHABLE: Node is not reachable from the root.
preflop3.err.E_CLASS_COVERAGE: Class rows are missing or incomplete.
preflop3.err.E_ROW_WIDTH: A row does not match the number of actions.
preflop3.err.E_NUMBER: A value is not a valid number (NaN, infinite or negative).
preflop3.err.E_SUM: A frequency row does not sum to 1.
preflop3.err.E_EV_SHAPE: The EV table does not match the frequency table.
preflop3.err.E_POT: Pot is inconsistent with the history.
preflop3.err.E_TOCALL: Amount to call is inconsistent with the history.
preflop3.err.E_STACK: A stack is inconsistent or exceeded.
preflop3.err.E_FIXTURE_IN_PROD: Test-fixture packs are not accepted in this build.
preflop3.err.E_JSON: The file is not valid JSON.
